overview: Put a bed in the loom with a dye and it comes out with a pattern on the blanket, in every pattern the loom offers and as many layers as a banner takes.

1.0.1: The same mod under a new version number, so the release had a file that could go up.
1.0.0: Beds go in the loom's banner slot and come out wearing the pattern. Break a patterned bed and you get the patterned bed back, so the design moves house with it, and beds standing side by side keep one pattern each.
Server side: Pandorical draws the pattern over the bed on the client, so there is nothing extra to install.
